name: War-Awoken Celestial Flash (Weapon Skill)
effects:
Single-target Ice/NE piercing physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & 30% DEF/RES Pierce to Ice Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold with at least Lv.0/2 En-Ice
WS Blue: Lv.2 En-Ice Stack to user
WS Gold: During Tactical Awoken Mode, chases an Ice ability with Quick ATB 3 (max 1 chase) to user
